item.title: 'Black History': Buffalo Criterion Newspaper celebrates 100th anniversary
item.description: If it happened in Buffalo, the Criterion was there to capture history and tell our stories. This Black History Month, we're highlighting that work as they celebrate a milestone.

item.title: 'We have joy': Handwritten valentines bring love to seniors feeling the weight of loneliness
item.description: With more than one in three older adults reporting loneliness, volunteers and children are handing out handmade cards to bring joy to East Amherst seniors this Valentine’s Day.

item.title: New York lawmakers revive push to allow wine sales in grocery stores
item.description: NY state lawmakers are once again considering legislation that would allow grocery stores to sell wine, reigniting a debate between major retailers and independent wine shop owners.

item.title: 'Strikes me as unusual': Sen. Ortt calls for investigation into Candlelight Cabinetry
item.description: State Senator Rob Ortt is calling on both the state Department of Labor and the Attorney General’s office to investigate Candlelight Cabinetry in Lockport. Also, owner Andrew Olsen provides an update.
